zh: 我刚刚才上车，感觉有点累。
old_en: I just got on the bus and I feel a bit tired.
new_en: I just got on and feel a bit tired.

zh: 今天早上我上飞机时带了早餐。
old_en: This morning, I got on the plane with breakfast.
new_en: This morning I brought breakfast when I got on the plane.

zh: 你可以在车门关闭前上车。
old_en: You can get on the bus before the doors close.
new_en: You can get on before the doors close.

zh: 我上车是因为要赶去开会。
old_en: I got on the train because I need to rush to a meeting.
new_en: I got on because I need to rush to a meeting.
